title: Constructing Dynamic Conversations with Neural Back-channel Generation and Voice-line Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2611.24086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a novel approach to the problem of combining two voice-line channels of dyadic conversational audio into a unified conversation with controllable back-channeling and turn-taking dynamics. In voice performances for the game industry, the two tracks of voice-lines are typically recorded or synthesized in isolation. Our method takes two such unsynchronized tracks and uses a neural scheduler to sequence them into a single dynamic conversation, modifying both tracks by inserting or removing pauses and introducing voice overlap as appropriate. We further propose a back-channel predictor that is able to predict opportunity for back-channels for a given conversational turn's audio and content, which the scheduler can then incorporate. We evaluate our scheduler and predictor independently and in combination by: various quantitative comparison; a qualitative and perceptual comparison to prior art and naive baselines; a compelling set

translated_title: 利用神经反馈信道生成与语音台词调度构建动态对话
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法，用于解决将双人对话音频的两个语音通道合并为统一对话的问题，该对话具有可控的反馈信道和话轮转换动态。在游戏行业的语音表演中，两条语音台词轨道通常是单独录制或合成的。我们的方法接收两条此类不同步的轨道，并使用神经调度器将其编排成单一的动态对话，通过插入或删除停顿并在适当时引入语音重叠来修改这两条轨道。我们进一步提出了一种反馈信道预测器，能够根据给定对话轮次的音频和内容预测插入反馈信道的时机，随后调度器可以将其纳入。我们通过多种定量比较、与先前技术和朴素基线的定性及感知对比评估了调度器和预测器的独立及组合表现，并给出了一组令人信服的结果。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种神经调度器与反馈信道预测器相结合的方法，能够将两条独立录制或合成的游戏语音台词轨道合并为具有自然话轮转换和反馈信道的单一动态对话。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a neural scheduler combined with a back-channel predictor that merges two independently recorded or synthesized game voice-line tracks into a single dynamic conversation with natural turn-taking and back-channeling.
